props.description: Watch this Block, its ports and the inspector as the theme changes

callouts.text: 1 · Open ☰ (top-left) → Settings → Appearance, and pick Dark Modern
2 · Click this Block so the inspector and the selection pill are on screen, then switch to Obsidian Dark, Obsidian Light, Dark, Light
3 · Import VS Code theme… and hand it any theme .json (Cursor ships them in /usr/share/cursor/resources/app/extensions/theme-defaults/themes); remove it with its ×
Shape colours are board content: the Block's port dots and any FigJam swatch you pick stay identical in every theme. Only the app around them changes.

PASS WHEN · The canvas, the inspector, the selection pill, tldraw's own ☰ menu and the Settings dialog all wear the chosen theme with every label readable — no white flash on reload, and the choice survives a reload.
